name: crew-companion
description: A Kiro 👻 desktop companion for KiroCrew. A ghost floats on your screen with no Dock icon, tells you the moment a session finishes, fails, or needs your OK, and lets you swap its avatar. This dashboard page manages the companion — see what every session is working on, review reminders and break nudges, and configure notifications — while the companion app itself runs on your Mac.
author: xuejint
highlights: Floating desktop ghost — a macOS accessory app with no Dock icon
Notifies you the moment a session finishes, fails, or needs your OK
Live view of what every KiroCrew session is working on
Reminders and gentle break nudges you set in plain language
Switchable avatar, including your own imported packs
